snapshot.text: Public national health service across nine inhabited islands, with complex cases evacuated to Portugal. The country plans a new national hospital and its first kidney transplant.

priorities.title: New national hospital
priorities.text: An international tender for building the national hospital.

priorities.title: First kidney transplant
priorities.text: The first kidney transplant was planned at the Dr. Agostinho Neto University Hospital.

priorities.title: Dengue and malaria prevention
priorities.text: A national clean-up campaign to prevent dengue and malaria.
